verdict.rationale: Convex's CLI docs state that when you change the schema, the generated types in convex/_generated are updated automatically. The homepage also claims end-to-end type safety, so the core of the story is delivered by the product itself. missing for 10: detailed docs on what the generated types contain and how client code consumes them, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can generate typed client code (e.g. TypeScript types) from my schema automatically

citations.quote: When you change a function or the schema, the new versions are pushed to your dev deployment and the generated types in convex/_generated are updated.
End-to-end type safety so agent hallucinations are caught before they ship
